Food.name: Grilled Tilapia
Food.description: Whole fish from the Volta, grilled over charcoal and served with banku and garden tomato stew.

Food.name: Jollof Rice & Chicken
Food.description: Smoky party jollof slow-cooked in a cast-iron pot, paired with spiced roast chicken and coleslaw.

Food.name: Kontomire Stew
Food.description: Cocoyam leaves simmered with garden eggs, smoked fish, and palm oil — served with boiled plantain.

Food.name: Kelewele Platter
Food.description: Spiced fried plantain tossed in ginger, cloves, and chilli — served with peanut dipping sauce.

Food.name: Garden Omelette
Food.description: Three-egg omelette filled with tomatoes, peppers, onions, and fresh herbs from the estate garden.

Food.name: Yam & Palava Sauce
Food.description: Boiled yellow yam with a rich cocoyam-leaf sauce, smoked salmon, and palm oil — a Thursday staple.

Food.name: Lamb Groundnut Soup
Food.description: Slow-braised lamb in a velvety groundnut broth with fresh tomatoes, served with fufu pounded to order.

Food.name: Forest Mushroom Stir-fry
Food.description: Wild oyster mushrooms from the estate, wok-fried with garlic, spring onions, and a splash of palm wine.

Food.name: Waakye Plate
Food.description: Rice and beans cooked together in millet stalks, served with wele, fried fish, spaghetti, and shito — the full works.

Drinks.name: House Sobolo
Drinks.description: Brewed in-house from dried hibiscus flowers, ginger, clove, and a pinch of cinnamon — served over ice.

Drinks.name: Fresh Coconut
Drinks.description: Young coconut served whole, chilled, with a straw — as nature intended.

Drinks.name: Tamarind Cooler
Drinks.description: Tamarind concentrate, sparkling water, lime, and a pinch of chilli salt.

Drinks.name: Star Beer
Drinks.description: Ghana's favourite lager, served ice cold.

Drinks.name: Club Beer
Drinks.description: Club Lager — crisp and light, brewed in Ghana since 1931. The one that earned its reputation on the terrace.

Drinks.name: Palm Wine
Drinks.description: Freshly tapped palm wine sourced from a local tapper — naturally fermented, slightly effervescent, and very Ghanaian.

Drinks.name: Malta Guinness
Drinks.description: The non-alcoholic malt drink Ghana runs on. Cold from the fridge, best with food.

Drinks.name: Alvaro Pineapple
Drinks.description: Light, sparkling pineapple drink — sweet without being cloying. A reliable non-alcoholic option.

Drinks.name: Akpeteshie Neat
Drinks.description: A measure of Ghana's traditional cane spirit — served straight, the old way. Not for the timid.

Cocktails.name: The Harmattan
Cocktails.description: Akpeteshie, dry ginger, fresh lime, honey, and a rim of smoked chilli salt. Dry season in a glass.

Cocktails.name: Garden Sling
Cocktails.description: Gin, hibiscus syrup, cucumber, mint, and tonic — long and botanical.

Cocktails.name: Volta Mule
Cocktails.description: Dark rum, ginger beer, lime, and a float of palm wine. Has a way of ordering a second round.

Cocktails.name: Pokrom Sunset
Cocktails.description: Campari, fresh orange, bitter lemon, and a wedge of dried mango on the rim.

Cocktails.name: The Night Watchman
Cocktails.description: Bourbon, tamarind bitters, demerara, orange peel — stirred, never shaken.

Small Bites.name: Chin Chin Bowl
Small Bites.description: Crispy fried dough twists, lightly sweetened — the bar snack Ghana grew up on.

Small Bites.name: Suya Skewers
Small Bites.description: Northern-style spiced beef skewers grilled over charcoal, served with sliced onion and tomato.

Small Bites.name: Garden Bruschetta
Small Bites.description: Toasted local bread topped with ripe tomatoes, basil, and a drizzle of chilli oil.

Small Bites.name: Peanut & Plantain Bites
Small Bites.description: Twice-fried plantain rounds topped with spiced groundnut paste and pickled pepper.

Small Bites.name: Fried Yam Wedges
Small Bites.description: Thick-cut yam fried until golden, seasoned with sea salt and served with a pot of shito on the side.
